SELECT co.name AS empresa,
  count(*) AS total,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.data_visita >= current_date - 90) AS ult_90d,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.visit_type = 'atendimento') AS atendimentos,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.status_visita = 'agendada') AS agendada,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.status_visita = 'confirmada') AS confirmada,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.status_visita = 'remarcada') AS remarcada,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.status_visita = 'realizada') AS realizada,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.status_visita = 'nao_compareceu') AS nao_veio,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.status_visita = 'cancelada') AS cancelada,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.responsavel_user_id IS NOT NULL) AS com_responsavel,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.unit IS NULL OR v.unit = '') AS sem_unidade,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.horario_visita IS NULL) AS sem_horario,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.observacoes ILIKE '%IA%') AS pela_ia,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.interest_level IS NOT NULL) AS com_qualificacao,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM visit_confirmation_history h WHERE h.company_id = co.id AND h.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days') AS confirmacoes_30d
FROM lead_visits v JOIN companies co ON co.id = v.company_id
GROUP BY co.id, co.name ORDER BY total DESC
